$comment: Standards conformance (saas-agent-skills SK5, design §7): `orun pr check --standards <mode>` (Go) and the cloud orun/compliance evaluator (TS) replay these cases and must emit exactly these findings, in this order, with these texts. A sibling of provenance-conformance.json, which stays the byte-identical v1 twin: that file proves the five rules under the default mode; this one proves the mode and the four rules that need facts the webhook cannot see (skillStatus, contract, affectsOutside, epic). Facts a caller cannot resolve are left out and the rule says nothing. ASCII-only inputs. Change only in lockstep with BOTH engines.
